in_marathi.name: Jay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root 'jaya' meaning 'victory'. In Hindu mythology, 'Jay' is associated with the god Vishnu, symbolizing triumph over negative forces and inner struggles. This name embodies courage, strength, and the promise of success.
